info.title: Ulo — House of Stories — Mobile API
info.description: Sanctum bearer JSON for Expo mobile (AGENTS.md.mobile + API.md). Base URL {APP_URL}/api/v1. Mirror of routes/api.php. Auth: Bearer <sanctum_token>. Public: GET /pricing, GET /share/rooms/{slug}.

device_name.description: Token name, defaults to User-Agent / mobile

token.description: Sanctum plainTextToken (store in expo-secure-store, send as Bearer)

423.description: Two factor required — resend with code/recovery_code

get.summary: Member dashboard (rooms, events, recentStories, stats, house_members)

post.summary: Create room (only general free, else 402 requires_checkout)

delete.summary: Delete guest media (orphaned before story, guest ownership via guest_name/email + room_slug/event_slug)

file.description: Binary — photo/audio ≤50MB, video ≤1GB (MAX_VIDEO_SIZE=1GB, MediaController max:1048576, room-share maxSizeMB 1024 for video)
